blurb: Profish Adventures offers guided salmon fishing charters in Campbell River, British Columbia, known as the Salmon Fishing Capital of the World. They provide experienced, personable, and professional local guides with proven salmon catching track records. The charters cater to all levels of fishing experience, including families and first-timers, with a focus on safety, comfort, and conservation.
